description: This file implements the SimpleBufferPool class, which manages a pool of static buffers for efficient memory allocation and deallocation, including handling dynamic fallback. It includes methods for allocating and freeing buffers, with internal metadata management.

classes.name: SimpleBufferPool
classes.description: A class that manages a pool of static buffers for efficient memory allocation, with fallback to dynamic memory allocation when necessary.

methods.name: SimpleBufferPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the static buffer pool with predefined buffer segments.

methods.name: ~SimpleBufferPool
methods.description: Destructor that releases the allocated static buffer.

methods.name: allocateImpl
methods.description: Allocates a buffer of the requested size, first attempting to find a suitable static buffer, falling back to malloc if none are available.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Frees a buffer, marking static buffers as free or calling free for dynamically allocated buffers.
